methodology: Counterfactual on rolling HI-11 shadow telemetry (7d corpus sample). Rows with gemini_two_axis source and niche_resolution_confidence in [threshold, 1.0) are counted as would-route candidates. Junction-valid subset requires junction_has_pair(slug, format_axis) AND creator_niche_has_content_class(inferred, cc_id). Estimates derived from two-axis-niche-model.md §9 corpus (6772 rows, 827 gemini overrides, 22 junction-invalid).

0.6.notes: Current _GEMINI_NICHE_CONFIDENCE_FLOOR. Maximizes recall; 22/6772 (0.33%) junction-invalid baseline acceptable for Wave 1a.

0.7.notes: Higher precision; ~25% fewer route overrides. Marginal reduction in junction-invalid rate (~15% relative) at cost of ~3pp fewer gemini_two_axis assignments.

recommendation.reason: Keep production floor at 0.6 until Wave 4 secondary junction edges land and junction-invalid rate drops below 0.2%. Raising to 0.7 deferrals outweigh precision gain while corpus still grows class coverage.
recommendation.revisit_trigger: junction_invalid_rate < 0.2% for 7 nights OR Wave 4 migration applied + ACQE proposals queue empty

completeness: 7/10 — estimates from audit baseline + rolling eval shape; live recount via hi11_rolling_eval after deploy recommended
